chart_contract.question: How does the average Zhuang retinotopic map warp onto the session's fixed anatomical CCF cell locations?
chart_contract.takeaway: Keep measured anatomy fixed and express animal/session-specific registration as deformation of the average retinotopic map.
chart_contract.family: paired spatial scatter over atlas contours
chart_contract.color: one shared viridis scale for azimuth cells/contours; one shared zero-centered coolwarm scale for elevation/altitude cells/contours
chart_contract.non_color_encoding: marker shape identifies Allen area; open circles and numeric suffixes mark penetration medians
chart_contract.coordinate_semantics: cells are plotted at released CCF ML/AP (ML horizontal, AP vertical), with both displayed axes descending high-to-low; all Zhuang layers are mapped into CCF by the exact inverse of the selected CCF-to-template affine
chart_contract.spatial_scaling: equal data aspect: one millimetre has the same rendered length on ML and AP
chart_contract.axis_limits: tight bounds of the warped cortical boundary plus cells, padded by 0.12 mm; unused rectangular template-canvas corners are excluded and the medial display edge is cropped at ML=6.75 mm
